subject: Change server.daylight_active to an atomic variable (#876)
reason: The change only makes server.daylight_active an _Atomic int with relaxed load/store, annotating a benign data race between the cron thread updating the DST flag and other threads reading it while formatting log timestamps. It changes no command reply, no log output, no replication/persistence/failover behavior — the loaded values are identical to the parent build. It is a pure thread-safety refactor visible only to ThreadSanitizer, so no fuzzer scenario can reach or distinguish it.
